flows.name: Add and sign in to an account

steps.note: First run: an empty state that explains the app and offers one action.
Import a detected session in one click, or name a new one. The folder hides under Advanced.
Three steps show progress; the code step only appears when the CLI asks for it.
Destructive actions live behind the more button, not on the card.
Rename, copy the alias, open the folder or remove.
A sheet states what will happen before anything is deleted.
The notice row pairs the problem with its fix.
Reconnect reuses the sign-in steps for the same folder.

notes.text: Real window is 380×620 and the list scrolls under the header; the frame shows the full list. The pace tick is the thin mark on each bar.
